Off the Books: Stacking
Stacking
Stack limits
Stacking enabled
Allow new stacking and apply category limits. Existing stacks keep their value and can still be split and used.
Smuggler's bays
Allow stacks in owned smuggler's bays.
Machine bays
Allow stacks in owned machine bays.
Loot crates
Allow stacks in owned engineering, medical, security, service and evidence crates.
Backpacks
Allow stacks in owned backpack grids.
Backpack stacking needs its upgrade
Require the backpack stacking upgrade before allowing stacks.
Requests take units from stacks
A marketplace request counts the units in a stack and takes only as many as it asks for. Off, a stack is handled by the setting below.
Barters take units from stacks
A barter counts the units in a stack and takes one unit for each thing it asks for. Off, a stack is handled by the setting below.
Refuse stacks when units are not taken
Refuse stacks for requests and barters when taking units is off or could not be installed. Split off single items first; otherwise the game may take the whole stack for one item.
Stack goods from different sellers

With Station Economy: equal goods stack even when they were bought from different sellers. Probably a Farm Story marks goods with the visit they came in, and that mark alone kept them apart. Real differences still do.
Stack goods with a mark that is switched off

With Station Economy: the game leaves some marks on goods after switching them off (stolen, on goods too cheap to count; challenged, after you bought them; water or household good, on a bottle that was filled or emptied). Such a mark alone kept goods from stacking with the same goods without it. Goods that really are stolen stay apart.
Stack empty bottles

With Station Economy: empty bottles and other empty liquid containers of one kind stack, whatever they held before, how warm it was and whether it was scanned. A container with anything in it is compared as before.
Look past a lock mark that is switched off
Goods that have been in a locked container keep a switched-off mark, and Station Economy then keeps them apart from equal goods. Goods that are behind a lock now are still kept apart.
Faucet Filter: a dropped stack gives one unit

Faucet Filter counts one unit for each drop and destroys what was dropped. With this on, a stack loses one unit and the rest stays. Only with Station Economy doing the stacking; Stacking's own engine has its own guard.
A customer who wants variety takes one unit of a stack

Such a customer buys each kind once, but a stack counts as one item, so a whole stack was bought as one kind. With this on, one unit stays on the counter for the customer and the rest is moved to the shop's storage. When the storage is full, what does not fit stays in the stack and is sold with it.
Look past a stated wear that equals the real wear
Some items carry a note of the wear a seller stated. When it says the same as the real wear, or is missing, items of equal wear stack. An item whose stated wear differs from the real one stays apart.
An item split off a stack keeps its types

With Station Economy: a genuine cigarette pack taken off a stack loses its Luxury Item type. With this on it gets the type back when it is put with a pack that kept it, and then stacks with the others.
Stack goods ordered by phone with the same goods from elsewhere

With Station Economy: goods you ordered by phone carry a mark that kept them apart from equal goods. With this on they stack, and the joined stack keeps the marks of the stack that took the others in: joined to a stack without the mark they lose it, joined to a stack with the mark the others gain it. Station Economy pays no premium at a tender for goods with the mark.
The rest of a used stack is never lost
With Station Economy: filling one jug in a stack when there is no room for the others no longer makes them vanish. They go to the main inventory, or stay on the stack.
A stack of parts is not used on an item that is gone
With Station Economy: a stack of metal or electronic parts dropped on an item that the first part replaces (a corrupted module is one) uses one part. Before, every further part made another new item.
